versions.content: RTE shall notify Dem in case of invalid value or out-of-range values is detected If data element invalidation is enabled (the handleInvalid has any value other than dontInvalidate ) or out-of-range check is enabled ( the han- dleOutOfRange has any value other than none ) for a data element, the RTE shall invoke the Dem_SetEventStatus API with DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREFAILED if the attribute ISignalPortToDiagnosticEventMapping . dataValueError is config- ured.
